messages.title: Thank you for testing!
messages.body: Thank you for testing out our next game! Here are 20 Gilded Keys to open some caches. If anything breaks, send us your Account ID (Settings tab) with the report.

messages.title: Welcome to the Enclave!
messages.body: Thanks for playing the early build. Farms are now per character and grow on longer, lazier timers; the Bank keeps coins top-left; and the Leave Combat button sends everyone back to the woodpile. Something broken? Quote your Account ID (Settings) when you tell us.
